raw_text: The access gravel road between Lusikisiki and Flagstaff near clinic has washed away completely after the storm. No ambulances can pass.
normalized_text_en: The access gravel road between Lusikisiki and Flagstaff near clinic has washed away completely after the storm. No ambulances can pass.

raw_text: Amanzi awekho ePort St Johns sele ziiveki ezintathu. Impompo zaphukile kwaye abantwana basela amanzi omlambo angcolileyo.
normalized_text_en: There has been no water in Port St Johns for three weeks. The pumps are broken and children are drinking contaminated river water.

raw_text: Ugesi awukho eSoweto emva kokudilika kwe-transformer eZone 4. Sekuphele izinyanga ezimbili sibika kodwa akekho osisizayo.
normalized_text_en: There is no electricity in Soweto after the transformer collapsed in Zone 4. We have been reporting this for two months without help.

raw_text: Die grondpad buite Komani is heeltemal weggespoel na die swaar reën. Boere kan nie die mark bereik nie en skoolbusse kan nie ry nie.
normalized_text_en: The gravel road outside Komani is completely washed away after heavy rain. Farmers cannot reach the market and school buses cannot run.

raw_text: Nyandeni primary healthcare clinic has had no running water or backup generator for 6 weeks. Maternity ward operating on candles.

raw_text: Isikolo sethu eLibode sisebenzisa izindlu zangasese eziyingozi zomgodi. Abantwana basengozini kakhulu kwaye amanzi awafiki.
